e.title: credibility (burning-cost)
e.summary: 现代可信度计算（burning-cost，PyPI 0.2.0）：Bühlmann/Bühlmann-Straub 权重，现代 Python 实现
e.summary_en: Modern credibility computation (burning-cost, PyPI 0.2.0): Bühlmann/Bühlmann-Straub weights, modern Python implementation
e.summary_hk: 現代可信度計算（burning-cost，PyPI 0.2.0）：Bühlmann/Bühlmann-Straub 權重，現代 Python 實現
e.body: credibility（burning-cost，PyPI v0.2.0）是现代 Python 的可信度计算实现：Bühlmann、Bühlmann-Straub 可信度权重——非寿险定价的经典方法现代化。对 RIAA：可信度理论是精算核心（[[insurance-credibility]] 家族的现代实现）——[[bayesian-pricing]]（贝叶斯分层）是延伸、本包是经典权重直接计算；与 [[insurance-experience]]（经验费率）配套；适合理解可信度理论的现代工程实践；经典方法 + 现代工程（clean API）的示范。
e.body_en: credibility (burning-cost, PyPI v0.2.0) is a modern Python implementation of credibility computation: Bühlmann and Bühlmann-Straub credibility weights — the classical method of non-life pricing modernised. For RIAA: credibility theory is core actuarial science (the modern implementation of the [[insurance-credibility]] family) — [[bayesian-pricing]] (hierarchical Bayesian) is the extension, this package computes the classical weights directly; pairs with [[insurance-experience]] (experience rating); suits understanding credibility theory through modern engineering; a demonstration of classical methods + modern engineering (clean API).
e.body_hk: credibility（burning-cost，PyPI v0.2.0）是現代 Python 的可信度計算實現：Bühlmann、Bühlmann-Straub 可信度權重——非壽險定價的經典方法現代化。對 RIAA：可信度理論是精算核心（[[insurance-credibility]] 家族的現代實現）——[[bayesian-pricing]]（貝葉斯分層）是延伸、本包是經典權重直接計算；與 [[insurance-experience]]（經驗費率）配套；適合理解可信度理論的現代工程實踐；經典方法 + 現代工程（clean API）的示範。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：PyPI v0.2.0 + GitHub README（家族成员），未实测
